pr.body:
## Problem

FL-IN-10 routes a Claude-authored PR to a Codex review. The author detector only recognised commit trailers (`Claude-Session:`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude`). Claude Code's **PR description** footer is different:

```
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_…
```

So every interactive Claude Code PR fell through to "unknown author" and was reviewed by **claude**: a self-review.

Audit of the 14 watched repos since the 2026-11-08 rollout: all 61 LCARS reviews ran on claude, 23 of them on PRs carrying the Claude Code footer. Example: #3275 got `pipeline: claude`, `allowedPipelines: [codex, agy]` (`lcars work owner jlapenna/agent-lcars#3275`).

## Fix

- `pr-review-routing.ts`: also treat `Generated with [Claude Code]` and a standalone `https://claude.ai/code/session_…` line as Claude authorship. An inline session link inside prose does not count.
- Tests: the footer routes to `codex` with fallback `[agy]`; an inline link stays unknown.
- Spec FL-IN-10 lists the new signal. R7 records that the review-fallback drill was skipped on 2026-11-09, so a production `provider-limit` reroute of a review run remains an open acceptance gap.

## Verification

- `vitest run apps/console/src/lib/pr-review-routing.test.ts`: 16 passed.
- Pre-push: console production bundle build + standalone smoke passed.
- Live check after deploy: the next Claude Code PR's Work item should show `pipeline: codex`.

Tracks #2198.
